name: agent-hub
description: A Claude-Code-web-style control center for driving coding agents from many vendors (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Codex, Claude Code CLI, Aider, ...) from one browser UI.

scripts.check: node --check server/index.js && for f in server/*.js server/adapters/*.js public/js/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
